[**Settings**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open) \> **AI innovations** lets you manage the list of AI features in DevTools.

To enable an AI feature:

1. [Open Settings](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open).
2. In the **AI innovations** tab, read the **Things to consider** at the top to better understand the usage of generative AI.
3. Turn on the toggle next to the AI feature. Expand the feature drop-down to learn more about the feature and privacy consideration.

There are two features:

- [Console insights](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/console/understand-messages). Understand console errors and warnings better with AI.
- [AI assistance](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance). Get help from AI to improve your development workflow with contextual explanations and suggestions.

![A list of AI features in the AI innovations tab.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/ai-innovations/image/ai-innovations.png)
